description: Curated AI/ML job-role knowledge base for CareerLens AI. Each role carries a description (the TF-IDF corpus document), responsibilities, and 8-18 required skills with per-(role,skill) importance weights in (0,1]. Weights decay down a fixed ladder from 1.00, so a role has a few genuinely critical requirements and a long tail of desirable ones.

roles.title: Machine Learning Engineer
roles.description: Design, train, evaluate and deploy machine learning models. Work across the full lifecycle: exploratory analysis, feature engineering, model selection, cross-validated evaluation, and packaging the trained model behind an API. Strong Python and Scikit-learn fundamentals are expected, with deep-learning experience in PyTorch for larger problems.
responsibilities: Design, train, evaluate and deploy machine learning models
Build reproducible training and evaluation pipelines
Collaborate with data engineering on feature pipelines
Monitor models in production and retrain as needed

roles.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
roles.description: Lead the design and delivery of machine learning systems. Owns evaluation methodology, model reliability and the technical direction of ML projects. Expected to mentor engineers, review model changes critically, and reason about failure modes rather than only headline accuracy.
responsibilities: Set the technical direction for ML projects
Design evaluation methodology and guard against leakage
Mentor engineers and review model changes

roles.title: Machine Learning Scientist
roles.description: Work on problems where the correct modelling approach is not yet known. Formulate the problem, design controlled experiments, and reason from first principles about optimisation, generalisation and statistical validity. Research output is expected, and negative results are treated as findings rather than failures.
responsibilities: Formulate research problems from ambiguous goals
Apply statistical rigour to model comparison

roles.title: Deep Learning Engineer
roles.description: Build and train deep neural networks with PyTorch, from computer vision architectures through to transformer-based sequence models. Expected to select and adapt pretrained checkpoints, implement efficient training loops, and diagnose optimisation instability rather than only tuning hyperparameters.
responsibilities: Implement and train deep neural architectures
Build efficient training and inference pipelines

roles.title: AI Engineer
roles.description: Build end-to-end AI products: Python services that expose models behind clean REST APIs, containerised with Docker and deployed on cloud infrastructure. Comfortable across the modelling boundary - able to train a baseline model and equally able to productionise it with tests, CI/CD and observability.
responsibilities: Build end-to-end AI features into production services
Work with data and platform engineers

roles.title: Generative AI Engineer
roles.description: Build applications on top of large language models. Combines prompt and retrieval design with engineering discipline: chunking strategies, vector search, evaluation harnesses, and cost control. Expected to measure output quality rather than judging by anecdote.
responsibilities: Build retrieval-augmented and tool-using LLM applications
Design and evaluate prompting and retrieval strategies
Guard against hallucination and cost blow-up

roles.title: LLM Engineer
roles.description: Own the architecture of LLM-based systems. Takes a model from prompt baseline through retrieval, fine-tuning and serving, and is responsible for measured quality, latency and cost. Deep familiarity with tokenisation, attention, and inference-time trade-offs is expected.
responsibilities: Own LLM application architecture end to end
Fine-tune and quantise models where retrieval is insufficient
Build offline and online evaluation suites
Optimise latency and cost per request

roles.title: NLP Engineer
roles.description: Build text-processing systems: normalisation, tokenisation, entity extraction and classification. Comfortable choosing between classical approaches such as regular expressions and CRF-style pipelines and transformer models, and able to justify the trade-off.
responsibilities: Train or fine-tune sequence models for NLP tasks
Design annotation schemes and labelling guidelines
Ship NLP services with latency budgets

roles.title: Computer Vision Engineer
roles.description: Build systems that interpret images and video. Trains and fine-tunes convolutional and transformer vision models, designs sensible augmentation, and cares about inference cost and latency rather than only offline accuracy.
responsibilities: Build and train image and video models
Design data augmentation and labelling strategies
Evaluate model quality on held-out real-world data

roles.title: Reinforcement Learning Engineer
roles.description: Work on sequential decision-making: design reward functions that do not invite specification gaming, build realistic simulation environments, and analyse policy behaviour. Statistical rigour matters more here than in almost any other ML setting.
responsibilities: Design reward functions and evaluation protocols
Analyse policy behaviour and failure modes

roles.title: Data Scientist
roles.description: Bridge statistics and business. Frames questions precisely, designs experiments that can actually detect the effect being looked for, builds validated predictive models, and communicates the result so that a decision can be made from it.
responsibilities: Frame business questions as statistical questions

roles.title: Senior Data Scientist
roles.description: Lead statistical strategy for a product area. Owns experiment design and causal analysis, mentors analysts, and is trusted to communicate uncertainty honestly rather than overclaiming from a single metric.
responsibilities: Own the statistical strategy for a product area
Design experiments and causal analyses others rely on

roles.title: Applied Scientist
roles.description: Sits between research and product: takes a real product problem, builds a model that works on real data under real constraints, and ships it. Expected to make pragmatic trade-offs between model sophistication and measurable business value.
responsibilities: Translate product problems into modelling problems
Build models that survive contact with production data
Balance model complexity against business value

roles.title: Analytics Engineer
roles.description: Build the modelled data layer that analytics depends on. Owns tested, documented transformations, data-quality contracts and lineage, so that analysts can trust the numbers without re-deriving them.
responsibilities: Build and maintain trustworthy data models

roles.title: Data Analyst
roles.description: Answer business questions using SQL and Python, and present the answer clearly. Expected to validate source data before trusting it and to communicate uncertainty rather than presenting a point estimate as if it were exact.
responsibilities: Answer business questions with SQL and Python

roles.title: Business Intelligence Analyst
roles.description: Build the dashboards and reports that stakeholders use daily. A large part of the value is in getting metric definitions right and documenting them, so that two people reading the same dashboard agree on what the number means.
responsibilities: Build dashboards and reports stakeholders rely on
Translate business questions into metric definitions

roles.title: Data Engineer
roles.description: Build and operate the pipelines the rest of the company depends on. Designs batch and streaming workloads, models data for analytical access, and treats data quality and pipeline cost as first-class concerns.
responsibilities: Design and operate batch and streaming pipelines
Manage cost and reliability of the pipeline estate

roles.title: Senior Data Engineer
roles.description: Set strategy for the data platform. Designs reliable observable pipelines, mentors engineers, and owns both platform cost and data governance so that the platform remains usable as it grows.
responsibilities: Mentor engineers on modelling and reliability

roles.title: Database Administrator
roles.description: Own the production database estate: provisioning, schema and index design, backup and restore, replication and incident response. Prioritises data integrity above availability when the two conflict.
responsibilities: Design schemas and indexes for real access patterns
Own backup, restore and disaster recovery
Respond to incidents with data integrity first

roles.title: Big Data Engineer
roles.description: Build distributed data systems and make them fast and cheap. Comfortable reasoning about partitioning, shuffles, join strategies and storage formats, and able to quantify the cost impact of a design decision.
responsibilities: Build distributed batch and streaming systems
Tune Spark workloads for cost and latency

roles.title: MLOps Engineer
roles.description: Own the operational half of machine learning: packaging models into services, automating retraining and promotion, instrumenting them, and managing the infrastructure they run on. The job is as much about reliability as about machine learning.
responsibilities: Build and maintain model deployment pipelines

roles.title: Machine Learning Infrastructure Engineer
roles.description: Design the compute and storage substrate that machine learning runs on. Responsible for scaling training and serving, and for making cost per unit of work a first-class engineering metric rather than an afterthought.
responsibilities: Design the compute and storage substrate for ML
Build scalable training and serving infrastructure
Optimise cost per unit of work

roles.title: Data Engineering Manager
roles.description: Lead a data engineering team. Sets the roadmap, grows engineers, and keeps platform work tied to measurable business outcomes rather than to technical preference.
responsibilities: Grow and mentor a team of data engineers
Align platform work with business outcomes

roles.title: ML Engineering Manager
roles.description: Lead a team delivering machine learning products. Balances exploratory work against delivery commitments, sets quality standards, and is accountable for outcomes rather than for models in isolation.
responsibilities: Own a team delivering ML products
Set technical direction and quality standards
Represent the team's work to stakeholders

roles.title: Head of Data Science
roles.description: Set data science strategy for the organisation: build the function, hold the experimentation bar across teams, and make sure analysis actually changes decisions rather than merely producing reports.
responsibilities: Set the data science strategy for the organisation
Build and mentor the data science function

roles.title: Computer Vision Research Engineer
roles.description: Advance the state of vision modelling on internal problems: design architectures and self-supervised objectives, run reproducible research, and convert findings into shipped capability.
responsibilities: Design self-supervised objectives for unlabelled data

roles.title: Speech and Audio Engineer
roles.description: Build speech and audio systems, from low-latency streaming recognition to audio-conditioned language models. Evaluated on word error rate and behaviour on real, noisy audio rather than on clean benchmarks.
responsibilities: Build speech recognition and audio understanding systems
Fine-tune pretrained audio and text models
Evaluate word error rate and robustness on real audio

roles.title: Recommender Systems Engineer
roles.description: Build the models that decide what a user sees next. Works across retrieval and ranking, designs both offline and online evaluation, and runs controlled experiments on live traffic.
responsibilities: Build and tune ranking and retrieval models
Run controlled experiments on live traffic
Balance relevance, diversity and business constraints

roles.title: Search Engineer
roles.description: Improve the relevance of search: lexical and semantic retrieval, ranking, and a genuine offline relevance evaluation set that is not just click-through data.
responsibilities: Improve ranking and relevance of search results
Run online experiments on search quality

roles.title: Knowledge Graph Engineer
roles.description: Model entities and their relationships, build the extraction and reconciliation pipelines that populate the graph, and serve it. Provenance for every fact is a hard requirement, not a nice-to-have.

roles.title: Time Series Forecasting Specialist
roles.description: Build forecasting systems and defend them. The hard part is backtesting without leakage and communicating prediction intervals honestly to people who need a number for planning.
responsibilities: Design rigorous backtesting that avoids leakage

roles.title: Forecasting Platform Engineer
roles.description: Operate the shared forecasting infrastructure. Point-in-time correctness of training features is the central concern: a pipeline that leaks future data will report accuracy that never materialises.
responsibilities: Operate shared forecasting pipelines at scale
Manage compute cost of batch inference

roles.title: Quantitative Researcher
roles.description: Research systematic signals and test them rigorously. Look-ahead bias and overfitting are the two failure modes that matter, so evaluation design is the core skill rather than the modelling.
responsibilities: Research and test systematic trading signals

roles.title: Risk Analyst
roles.description: Quantify and monitor risk. Builds scenario and stress analyses and reports them to people who will act on them, which makes clarity as important as the arithmetic.

roles.title: Cloud Engineer
roles.description: Provision and operate cloud infrastructure. Everything is defined in code, security and cost are guardrails rather than afterthoughts, and hand-run configuration is treated as a defect.
responsibilities: Automate provisioning with infrastructure as code

roles.title: Site Reliability Engineer
roles.description: Keep production systems available and improve the systems that make availability sustainable. Expected to lead incident response, write honest postmortems, and alert on symptoms rather than on causes.
responsibilities: Define SLOs and alert on symptoms

roles.title: DevOps Engineer
roles.description: Automate the path from commit to production. Improves deployment frequency and safety through pipelines, containers and infrastructure as code, and reduces manual steps deliberately.
responsibilities: Automate build, test and deploy pipelines

roles.title: Kubernetes Administrator
roles.description: Operate Kubernetes clusters: upgrades, networking and scheduling problems, security policy, and cluster provisioning. Much of the value is in knowing the failure modes well enough to diagnose them quickly.

roles.title: Platform Engineer
roles.description: Build internal platforms that make product teams faster. Success is measured by whether engineers choose the paved road, which makes developer experience the primary design constraint.
responsibilities: Build internal platforms that make teams faster
Design paved roads and self-service tooling

roles.title: Backend Engineer
roles.description: Build and maintain backend services. Designs APIs others can consume, models relational data carefully, and treats automated tests as part of the definition of done rather than as an extra step.
responsibilities: Design and build backend services and APIs
Model relational data and manage migrations

roles.title: Senior Backend Engineer
roles.description: Set architecture direction for backend systems. Reviews designs, owns the reliability and performance of critical services, and is expected to mentor rather than only to contribute.
responsibilities: Review design and code across the team
Own reliability and performance of critical services

roles.title: Frontend Engineer
roles.description: Build accessible, responsive user interfaces against real APIs, including the loading, empty and error states that most product surfaces forget. Design-system consistency is treated as a feature.
responsibilities: Consume REST APIs with proper loading and error states
Maintain design consistency across the product

roles.title: Full Stack Engineer
roles.description: Ship features across the whole stack: interface, API and data model. The value is in keeping those three coherent, so the data model is designed with the interface in mind rather than after it.
responsibilities: Ship features across the whole stack
Design APIs and the interfaces that consume them
Own features from prototype to production

roles.title: Software Engineer
roles.description: Implement and maintain software features across a stack. Expected to write real tests, review others' code constructively, and debug systematically rather than by guesswork.
responsibilities: Review code and improve team practices

roles.title: QA Automation Engineer
roles.description: Design and maintain automated test suites that the team trusts. A test suite that is flaky gets ignored, so reliability is treated as the primary quality bar rather than coverage percentage.
responsibilities: Design and maintain automated test suites

roles.title: Product Analyst
roles.description: Instrument the product, analyse funnels, design and read experiments, and translate the result into a decision. Expected to say what the data does not show as well as what it does.

roles.title: Business Intelligence Developer
roles.description: Build the semantic and reporting layers over modelled data. Metric definitions and documentation are treated as deliverables, not as overhead.

roles.title: Research Scientist
roles.description: Conduct primary research on problems where the answer is not known. Designs ablations that genuinely isolate a single variable, and keeps every experiment reproducible enough for someone else to re-run it.
responsibilities: Conduct primary research and publish findings
Design ablations that isolate one variable

roles.title: AI Ethics and Governance Specialist
roles.description: Assess AI systems for fairness, harm and compliance, and turn the assessment into documentation and monitoring that a deployment team will actually follow.
responsibilities: Assess AI systems for fairness and harm
Monitor deployed systems for drift in impact

roles.title: Data Engineer for Analytics
roles.description: Build pipelines optimised for analytical query patterns rather than for transaction processing. Data quality contracts matter because analysts cannot wait for a pipeline while investigating a question.
responsibilities: Build pipelines that serve analytics specifically
Support ad-hoc analysis without breaking models

roles.title: Analytics Engineer Manager
roles.description: Lead the analytics engineering function: set modelling standards, mentor engineers, and keep the modelled layer aligned with how the business actually asks questions.
responsibilities: Align the modelled layer with business needs

roles.title: Junior Data Analyst
roles.description: The entry-level analyst role: routine questions answered correctly, simple reports built and maintained, data validated before use, and learning the methods properly under mentorship.

roles.title: Junior Software Developer
roles.description: The entry-level developer role: implement well-scoped features under mentorship, test what you write, and learn the codebase's conventions well enough to follow them.
responsibilities: Write unit tests for new code
Learn the codebase and its conventions

roles.title: AI Engineering Intern
roles.description: Supports AI feature development: preparing data, running and documenting experiments, and assisting with evaluation. Work is supervised, and the emphasis is on writing things down so others can continue them.

roles.title: Technical Program Manager
roles.description: Coordinate delivery across teams: track dependencies, surface risks early, and keep stakeholders informed without drowning them in detail.

roles.title: Fraud Analyst
roles.description: Detect fraud: engineer features for anomalous behaviour, tune the false-positive/missed-fraud tradeoff against real operational cost, and explain individual decisions to investigators who must act on them.
responsibilities: Build and tune fraud detection models
Balance false positives against missed fraud

roles.title: Marketing Data Scientist
roles.description: Support marketing with rigorous experimentation and honest attribution. Segmentation and lifetime-value modelling are the core deliverables.
responsibilities: Model customer segmentation and lifetime value

roles.title: Healthcare Data Scientist
roles.description: Build predictive models on health data under strict governance. Evaluation metrics must be clinically meaningful, and every model must be documented for clinical review rather than judged on accuracy alone.
responsibilities: Build predictive models on sensitive health data
Work within strict governance and consent constraints

roles.title: Fintech Machine Learning Engineer
roles.description: Build real-time decision models in a regulated setting. Features must remain valid under drift, models are monitored for performance *and* fairness, and every model is documented for regulatory review.
responsibilities: Build real-time decision models in regulated settings
Design features that remain valid under drift
Monitor models for both performance and fairness

roles.title: Retail Forecasting Data Scientist
roles.description: Forecast demand at product and location granularity for supply-chain planning. Intervals matter more than point estimates, because planners act on the range.
responsibilities: Forecast demand at product and location granularity

roles.title: Manufacturing Quality Engineer
roles.description: Detect process anomalies and predict equipment failure in a plant. Work is collaborative with plant engineers, and models are deployed close to the equipment.
responsibilities: Detect process anomalies and predict equipment failure
Work with plant engineers on root cause
Deploy models on edge and cloud

roles.title: Autonomous Systems Engineer
roles.description: Perceive and plan in dynamic environments. Integrates perception, localisation and control, and is evaluated against both simulation and real hardware because simulation alone hides failure modes.
responsibilities: Perceive and plan in dynamic environments
Handle sensor noise and failure modes

roles.title: Edge AI Engineer
roles.description: Deploy models onto constrained hardware. Quantisation and compression accuracy loss is measured rather than assumed, and latency and power budgets are treated as hard requirements.
responsibilities: Optimise and quantise models for constrained hardware

roles.title: Game AI Engineer
roles.description: Design non-player character behaviour, from authored behaviour trees to trained policies, under a hard frame-time budget. Behaviour is judged on how the game plays, not only on a benchmark.
responsibilities: Balance behaviour against fun and fairness

roles.title: Quantum Machine Learning Researcher
roles.description: Explore quantum approaches to machine learning problems, with the specific discipline of assessing honestly where classical methods remain superior. Negative results are the expected output as often as positive ones.
responsibilities: Explore quantum approaches to ML problems
Assess where classical methods remain superior

roles.title: Conversational AI Designer
roles.description: Design multi-turn conversations: the flow, the system prompt, and the success criteria by which the dialogue is judged. Works directly with engineers on retrieval and grounding.
responsibilities: Define success criteria for dialogue quality
Work with engineers on retrieval and grounding

roles.title: Responsible AI Auditor
roles.description: Audit deployed models and track remediation to completion. Produces assessment reports that stand up to external scrutiny rather than internal reassurance.
responsibilities: Audit deployed models for fairness and transparency

roles.title: Developer Advocate
roles.description: Build demos, tutorials and reference applications, and carry developer feedback back to the team. Success is measured by whether developers can succeed using the documentation unaided.
responsibilities: Represent developer feedback to the team

roles.title: Operations Analyst
roles.description: Support operational decisions with data and build the recurring reports the team runs on. Anomalies are surfaced for someone else to act on, so precision about uncertainty matters.
responsibilities: Flag anomalies for the operations team

roles.title: Supply Chain Analyst
roles.description: Forecast demand and optimise inventory, balancing service level against holding cost. The deliverable is usually a set of trade-offs, so the analysis must be presentable to planners.
responsibilities: Run what-if scenarios for supply decisions
Balance service level against holding cost

roles.title: Pricing Analyst
roles.description: Estimate price elasticity and design pricing experiments. The value is in quantifying the revenue impact of a price change and being honest about the uncertainty in that number.
responsibilities: Model the revenue impact of price changes

roles.title: Credit Risk Analyst
roles.description: Build credit scoring models and validate them against realised outcomes. Fairness monitoring and regulatory documentation are requirements, not enhancements.
responsibilities: Monitor models for drift and fairness

roles.title: Customer Analytics Manager
roles.description: Own the customer analytics roadmap: lead experiment design across teams, mentor analysts, and turn analysis into commercial decisions.

roles.title: Data Governance Manager
roles.description: Own data policy and standards, and run the quality and lineage programmes that make them real. Coordination across teams is the hard part; policy nobody adopts is worthless.

roles.title: Sports Data Analyst
roles.description: Model player and team performance and build predictive models for outcomes. The audience is coaches, so the presentation carries as much weight as the model.
responsibilities: Communicate findings to coaches and analysts

roles.title: Content Data Scientist
roles.description: Measure content performance, build recommendation and classification models, and run content experiments. The output must be actionable for editorial teams, not just accurate.

roles.title: Research Data Engineer
roles.description: Build the data infrastructure research depends on, where dataset provenance and reproducibility are the central requirements rather than nice-to-haves.

roles.title: Analytics Engineer for Experimentation
roles.description: Build the assignment and exposure tables that experiments depend on. A subtle error here silently biases every experiment result, so point-in-time correctness is the whole job.
responsibilities: Build assignment and exposure tables for experiments
Maintain metric definitions used by experiments

roles.title: Machine Learning Product Manager
roles.description: Define ML product requirements and, importantly, decide where machine learning is *not* the right answer. Manages model quality as a product concern rather than a research concern.
responsibilities: Define ML product requirements and success metrics
Decide where ML is genuinely appropriate
Manage model quality as a product concern

roles.title: ML Solutions Architect
roles.description: Design end-to-end ML system architectures and advise on approach. Balances cost, latency and accuracy explicitly, and prototypes reference implementations so the design is grounded in something that ran.
responsibilities: Advise customers on the right approach

roles.title: Machine Learning Infrastructure Lead
roles.description: Lead the ML infrastructure team, owning both reliability and cost at scale. Sets standards the team can apply without asking for approval each time.
responsibilities: Own reliability and cost at scale

roles.title: Data Scientist Manager
roles.description: Manage and grow a data science team: allocate work across the portfolio, hold the experimentation bar, and represent the team honestly to leadership.
responsibilities: Manage and grow a data science team
